subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw core mutate workspace Markdown at write time, and if so should that behavior be opt-in and parser-backed across Gateway, agent-tool, and skill write APIs?
rationale: The requested behavior is not a broken existing contract; it changes default content persistence and adds config/API surface on stable Gateway workspace paths.

options.title: Require opt-in parser-backed design
options.body: Keep the issue open but require maintainer-sponsored design before implementation, with no default mutation until parser safety and write-path coverage are proven.

options.title: Decline core write-time mutation
options.body: Close or mark not planned if maintainers decide Markdown cleanup belongs in authoring tools, docs lint, or external workspace tooling rather than OpenClaw runtime writes.

options.title: Accept default auto-fix
options.body: Proceed with the original default-on direction, accepting the compatibility and content-mutation risk after explicit maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Require opt-in parser-backed design
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but require maintainer-sponsored design before implementation, with no default mutation until parser safety and write-path coverage are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the listed project lead and has the strongest adjacent current-main/history signal for the affected core and markdown surfaces.
